pr.description: PR number the comment belongs to.

thread_id.description: Thread id from the source record (verbatim).

url.description: Permalink to the comment (verbatim from the record).

source.description: Which comment source this thread came from (verbatim from the record).

substantive.description: true if this carries a generalizable review lesson (correctness, design, convention, security, testing, maintainability, docs). false for nits, pure style, logistics ('rebase please'), praise, or chit-chat. Be strict: when in doubt about whether a future reviewer would care, mark false.

category.description: Best-fit review dimension. See references/categories.md. Use 'emergent' only when none of the named dimensions fit.

verdict.description: What actually happened to the feedback, judged from evidence: addressed = the post-comment delta / resolution shows the change was made; rejected = author/thread explicitly declined; ignored = no reply, unresolved, and no relevant code change; acknowledged-no-change = discussed/agreed but code intentionally left as-is; unclear = evidence insufficient.

confidence.description: Confidence in the verdict given the available evidence. Use 'low' when code_context is partial/none.

code_context.description: Verbatim from the record: how much code evidence backed the judgement.

lesson.description: ONE generalizable reviewer rule distilled from this comment, phrased so it could appear on a review checklist for ANY future PR (not specific to this file). Empty string if substantive is false.

quote.description: The most telling sentence(s) from the original comment, verbatim, trimmed to <=300 chars.
